CustomField.description: The gate checks of the GlassOps run as a JSON array of rule and outcome pairs, where outcome is pass, fail or skipped. For a drill run it holds the checks that denied the change. Holds no secrets. Copied from the governance event.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A JSON array such as [{"rule":"validate_passed","outcome":"pass"}]. Set by the workflow, never typed.
CustomField.label: Gate Checks
